CLIMASTRA – Climate Strategy and Analytics is a new Indian environmental consultancy dedicated to bringing innovative and science-based solutions to the modern changing environmental and climate concerns. The organization integrates expertise in hydrodynamic and hydraulic modeling, climate change assessment, pollution research, remote sensing and GIS, and environmental analysis to promote sustainable development and informed decision-making.
CLIMASTRA is aware that environmental issues are increasingly interlinked. To address floods, water-resource restrictions, pollution, changing climate conditions, ecosystem stresses, and rapid urban growth, integrated approaches are required that combine scientific understanding with advanced analytical techniques. Thus, our work integrates environmental research, numerical modeling, geospatial technology, climate analytics, and data-driven methodologies.
Our technical services include hydrodynamic and hydraulic modeling of rivers, drainage systems, floodplains, reservoirs, and urban and coastal environments; climate change studies, including climate risk, vulnerability, impact, and adaptation assessments; and pollution and environmental studies focusing on understanding environmental processes, pollutant pathways, impacts, and mitigation measures. We use remote sensing and GIS to deliver spatial analysis, environmental mapping, watershed and land-use assessments, monitoring, and decision support solutions.
CLIMASTRA is a young and emerging consultancy, set up to be agile, collaborative, and innovation-oriented. We want to build solutions that are technically sound but practical, clear, and sensitive to the individual requirements of each project. Our approach emphasizes understanding the problem, selecting appropriate scientific and analytical methods, and translating complex environmental information into clear, actionable outcomes.
CLIMASTRA aims to collaborate with government bodies, infrastructure and development organizations, industry, research institutes, academic bodies, and other stakeholders to address environmental hazards and build climate-resilient, sustainable systems.
Our aim is to become the most trusted provider of climate, water, and environmental intelligence that helps organizations foresee risks, comprehend environmental change, and make smarter decisions for a more resilient and sustainable future.

CLIMASTRA - translating climate and environmental data into insight, strategy, and action.
